verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. Typesense can be fully self-hosted under GPL-3.0 on your own machine or server, and you push in your own data, so retention is implicitly under your control. Nothing in the pack documents deletion APIs, retention policies, or data-deletion guarantees for Typesense Cloud. Missing for 10: documented document/collection deletion endpoints, configurable retention or TTL controls, a Cloud data-retention and deletion policy, and independent corroboration.
